message: 人は見かけが９割？

name: Aikawa-san
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Synn
message: 「*Flinch*」
Why do all the clerks at this shop have crew cuts, wear sunglasses, look weirdly muscular, or have dragon tattoos peeking out from their sleeves... S-Scary.

name: Aikawa-san
message: 「Much obliged as always, Boss. We look forward to your continued patronage」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah! I'm counting on you for some delicious cakes!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. We even got souvenirs~」
Well, that's fine and all. The cake was delicious, too. Still.

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Sans Souci' is setting up a booth at KiraFes, too. With that, we've completely conquered all three cake shops on our list outside the shopping district!」
Nanaka draws a sharp red line across the cake shop list written in her notepad.

name: Synn
message: 「Is that shop... really okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The cheesecake was delicious, wasn't it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It was super yummy~」
Sacchin, who is tagging along for some reason.

name: Paqy
message: 「It was tasty」

name: Synn
message: 「That's true. Even so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The flavor's around 69 points, easily top one or two in this town」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, yeah. If we're talking food tour... ahem, getting booths for KiraFes, you can't leave that shop out~」

name: Synn
message: 「69 points doesn't feel like a very high score to me」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I've never seen Nana-chan give anything over 75 points~」

name: Synn
message: 「Your standards are too harsh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, duh! The God of Sweets has discerning taste, so I have to devote myself wholeheartedly and help elevate the sweets of this world!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan's nonsense aside, 69 points is high~」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it really...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean, 'nonsense'? *Grind, grind*」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Stop with the knuckle-rubs~ My brain, which is as delicate as whipped cream inside a head as soft as sponge cake, is gonna pop right out~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you can talk back like that, there's no need to hold back」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Waaah\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, you mustn't bully the turtle」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you, Urashima Taro?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I had no idea there was a shop like this right in the middle of a residential area」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Can't blame you for not knowing, Synn. It only just opened at the end of last year」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's just a regular house they fixed up a bit, so it's pretty easy to miss」

name: Synn
message: 「It certainly is plain」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plus, the staff are all middle-aged guys--none of the super-cute girls you like, Synn」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zero appeal for Master Synn, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「My character is being pretty heavily distorted here」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So you're that kind of guy, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, don't believe that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It might not be up your alley, Synn, but it can't be helped」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Apparently, that place was opened by a trio of guys who washed their hands of the *akuza and poured all their savings into their cake-making hobby to carve out a rosy new life」
So that's why they have buzz cuts, wear sunglasses, look weirdly bulky, and have dragon tattoos peeking out from their sleeves.
Still...

name: Synn
message: 「Carve out a rosy new life, huh...」
I actually kind of relate to that part. They put it differently, sure, but those guys were yearning for a sparkling, exciting life too.

name: Synn
message: 「Even if the food is good, can they really turn a profit in the middle of a residential neighborhood?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds like it's pretty tough, yeah. They're away from the shopping district, and they all have scary faces」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that's exactly why they agreed to set up a booth at KiraFes! It'll be good publicity for them」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll have to make sure it pays off for them too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, I don't want that shop going under either」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, yeah, delicious sweets shops are a treasure to the world. Plus, if we get them to open a stall, they might even let us eat at a special Sweets Club discount--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Don't spill the secret!」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's your real motive」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys are always faithful to your desires」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you talking about? Now then, to the shopping district we go」
At the entrance to the shopping district, a girl who had been alternating bites between a crepe in her right hand and one in her left raised a hand toward us.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yumil, sorry to keep you waiting」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yo! Yuugiri-senpai. Sacchin-senpai.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah! You're already eating!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Expected nothing less from the Sweets Club's promising rookie. We really need to learn from that aggressive, always-eating attitude.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Nah, I just got super hungry」

name: Synn
message: 「Hearty as ever, huh」

name: Yumil
message: 「Long time no see too, President Sakura. Yo」

name: Synn
message: 「Yo」

name: Yumil
message: 「Ngulp, gulp」
The two crepes were swallowed down in an instant.

name: Yumil
message: 「Haaah... Soo good!」

name: Yumil
message: 「So, how'd things go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Smoothly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Sans Souci' said they'll open a stall」

name: Yumil
message: 「Now that's something to look forward to. So, where do we start our food crawl? Wanna carpet-bomb the shopping district end to end? Khh, I'm trembling with excitement」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... how on earth did you explain this to her?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I told her it was our first club activity in a while」

name: Synn
message: 「Wrong!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Come on, Nana-chan. It's not a food crawl. We're helping out the Student Council. As the treasurer, you shouldn't be saying stuff like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look who's talking, Mr. All-I-Do-Is-Eat」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~ You're just imagining things~\s05」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Besides, I was a squirrel in my past life, so I have to be eating all the time~」

name: Synn
message: 「You were?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep. Just decided right now~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To really liven up Kirafes, we've got to get all the delicious cake shops in Ryuusei Town to participate, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, setting up a stall doesn't necessarily mean they'll turn a profit, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「On that front, we'll just have to convince them that it'll be good publicity, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It'll be fine~ If Nana-chan asks, everyone'll say okay~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Ain't no shop gonna say no when Yuugiri-senpai asks 'em」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right~」
There's no way things will go that smoothly.

name: Nanaka
message: 「As long as we get them to see that Kirafes will draw a crowd, it'll be fine. Well, I'm leaving that whole persuasion part to you, Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, you bet」
That's a huge responsibility.

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat?! You'll really open a stall for us?」
Even though I haven't even explained the details yet....

name: Nanaka
message: 「We did it, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So good, so good, so goood! Pure blisss~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Nom nom, munch munch, chomp chomp」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop stuffing your faces and move on to the next one!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much for agreeing on such short notice」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you so much」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We did it, Synn. Easier done than worried over, just like they say」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」
Something feels off...

name: Sacchin
message: 「So good, so good, so gooood!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Nom nom, munch munch, chomp chomp」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on! Next stop, next stop!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, we'll follow up with the details later. Let's go, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right.」
Weird... things are going too smoothly.
Why is everyone agreeing without even opening the pamphlets we hand them?

name: Sacchin
message: 「This is so good~ Haaah. This cream is just exquisite~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Nom nom, munch munch, chomp chomp」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Today isn't a club activity! We're moving on!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Yumil
message: 「Munch munch, nom nom.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, let's go!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah. I haven't ordered the Mont Blanc yet~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Save that for next time! Up you go, up you go.」
It feels like every clerk and store manager agreed to set up a booth the instant they saw Nanaka... or is it just my imagination...?

name: Nanaka
message: 「With that, the only one left is Chocolat l'Or.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「When are we going there to eat~」

name: Yumil
message: 「I'm down to go right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「You two, we're not out on a food tour today, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah! Besides, you guys have to be stuffed already.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Busted~」

name: Yumil
message: 「I could still eat, though scarfing down more would look pretty uncool. Plus, Chocolat is right about to hit its rush hour.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「True. Let's save Chocolat for another day!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still... you're amazing, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, even so, I probably can't eat as much as Yumil」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I mean--it seemed like almost every shop knew who you were, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heheh. After all, I am the Belle of the Ryuusei Shopping District!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a tiny territory」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Could it be... you have dirt on the shops or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How rude of you. As if that's true」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. It's just that things went a little too smoothly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's all thanks to my everyday good character」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, yeah. It's the fruit of the Sweets Club's everyday activities~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since we're so active, I wonder if we could get promoted to an official club」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you look at me with those begging eyes, it's a no」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stingy」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well then, let's call it a day for today~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Later then, Senpai. Farewell!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, shall we head home too?」
Oh?

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, this place is a cake shop, right?」
I point at the dingy sign that reads 'Peace Tanimura Patisserie'.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ohh, they swapped out the sign~」

name: Synn
message: 「Swapped it out?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...They changed it back」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Before, it had some kind of fancy \{French-sounding|\s12\s12\s12\s12\s12} name~」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder why they changed it back?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Too late for that now」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not there. The food's awful」

name: Synn
message: 「Writing them off just like that!?」
True enough, there aren't any customers inside, and the guy who looks like the owner is sighing with a face like he's about to hang himself. It's obvious at a glance that business is dead.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm... Well, a lot happened, you know... Plus, it really doesn't taste good~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka. Is it really that bad?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't even want to talk about it」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't that going a bit too far...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Buuut, even Yumil said it was gross~」
And that girl looks like she'd eat just about anything...

name: Synn
message: 「What about Sally-chan, then?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She'd say it's gross~ ...If it's still the same as before」

name: Synn
message: 「When was 'before'?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You really don't get it, Synn-kun~ Asking me about stuff that far back is totally pointless~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Six months ago」

name: Synn
message: 「Then maybe it's gotten better since then」
Looking at the state of the shop, though, that seems pretty hopeless.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not a chance. This owner is rotten to the core」

name: Synn
message: 「...Come on, isn't that a little harsh? Aren't you just prejudiced because the shop is dirty?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The shop's appearance has nothing to do with it. Not at all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because back in the previous owner's day, it was way, way dirtier」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? It used to be even dirtier than this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Anyway, I refuse to deal with this shop」
However, and yet! Variety is the lifeblood of a cake buffet.
I want to get as many shops to participate as possible
Besides, if we promote places like this and bring in customers, it'll also help revitalize the shopping district.

name: Synn
message: 「I'll go negotiate with them!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...There's no need for that」

name: Synn
message: 「No, come on. Don't you think it'd be unfair to leave out just one cake shop in the shopping district?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. I'll go negotiate by myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「And that's why it's such a meaningful event」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「So, we'd really love for you to participate in KiraFes. Please」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「It does sound like a meaningful event, yeah. We just don't really have the leeway for it」

name: Synn
message: 「...Is that so」
Well, since it's for charity, I guess not making a profit is tough.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「! Y-You!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Who is that girl waiting outside to you?」
His trembling finger points toward Nanaka.

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, um, she's our Student Council treasurer, why?」
For some reason, the shop manager's face suddenly brimmed with life.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「That means if I set up a stall, there's a chance my cakes might actually make it into her mouth?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder... I think she'd eat it if you put out a new cake, though」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Is that right! Then, if you accept just one condition, I'll gladly set up a stall」

name: Synn
message: 「A condition...?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I'll bring a brand-new cake to KiraFes, so you have to make sure she eats it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... is that really all you want?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「If she'll eat it, I'll do anything! I'll even lick your shoes!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't need that kind of service. If there's a new cake, I'm sure she'll eat it without even being ask--」
Wait, would she really?
Because for some reason, Nanaka seems to hate this shop.
The manager smiled a little sadly.

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「If she finds out it's from my place, she probably won't eat it」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「If possible... when you have her try it, I don't want you to mention my shop's name at first」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hmm. Well, I can manage that much, at least」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Really?! Then I'll open a stall! Thank you! Thank you so much!」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Synn
message: 「He agreed to open a stall」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I just hope it doesn't ruin the buffet's reputation」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, look, it's been half a year, so maybe things have changed」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way. That place is the worst-tasting restaurant in all of Ryuusei Town. And it never got any better, either」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Totallly. Plus, that guy gets mad when people say his food tastes bad. And then he goes on a whole speech about how things are done in France~」

name: Synn
message: 「He didn't seem like that kind of person to me, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I never want to eat anything from there again. Actually, no thanks from me altogether」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you hate it so much...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry, Synn, but that's the one place I'm passing on」
No wonder he asked me to hide the shop's name.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. Could it be that the manager made getting Nana-chan to eat his food a condition or something~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's nothing like that\s01」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm. Surprising. I totally thought that was it~」
Why is Sacchin always so sharp about stuff like this?

name: Nanaka
message: 「I am never, ever eating it again, not in a million years!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, alright. Is it really that bad?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It. Is. Awful!」
If she finds out, I might be in danger. Still... I already promised...
Even so, why is the manager so fixated on Nanaka...
